versions.detection:
selection:
    - CommandLine|contains: ':\Windows\Sysnative\'
    - Image|contains: ':\Windows\Sysnative\'
filter_main_ngen:
    Image|contains:
        - 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v'
        - 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework\v'
        - 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\FrameworkArm\v'
        - 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\FrameworkArm64\v'
    Image|endswith: '\ngen.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'install'
filter_optional_xampp:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '"C:\Windows\sysnative\cmd.exe"'
        - '\xampp\'
        - '\catalina_start.bat'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*
versions.spl: CommandLine="*:\\Windows\\Sysnative\\*" OR Image="*:\\Windows\\Sysnative\\*" NOT (Image IN ("*C:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework64\\v*", "*C:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework\\v*", "*C:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\FrameworkArm\\v*", "*C:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\FrameworkArm64\\v*") Image="*\\ngen.exe" CommandLine="*install*") NOT (CommandLine="*\"C:\\Windows\\sysnative\\cmd.exe\"*" CommandLine="*\\xampp\\*" CommandLine="*\\catalina_start.bat*")
